culprit_citations.quoted_text: Foreside Financial Group, LLC / First Lien(8)(9) - Undrawn / purchase 05/2022 / maturity 09/2027 / principal 581 / cost (1) / fair value dash

findings.detail: The flagged Foreside undrawn position is sourced from the comparative-period SOI block tying to 2024 total investments of 1516623, not the 2025 schedule total of 2006885.

rationale: Class 2 within-row review. The current 2025 SOI block totals to fair value 2006885 at table 48 row 25 and has separate current Foreside rows in tables 33 and 42. The flagged Foreside Financial Group, LLC First Lien - Undrawn 2 row is localized to the later comparative SOI block at table 66 row 4, and that block ties to the prior-period investment total 1516623 shown at table 78 row 7. Retaining that comparative-period row under report_date 2025 is therefore a real comparative-period leak, not a false alarm.
